guides.definition: Uses D3's data join to create one list item per value. Browser/editor content: import D3 in the target page or bundle; Hypershell's Web APIs surface is intentionally editor-only.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: CSS selector for the parent element.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Element selector and tag passed to join.

parameters.name: labelExpression
parameters.description: Text returned for each data value.

examples.title: Render project names
examples.explanation: join handles entering, updating, and exiting elements for the current data array.

guides.definition: Maps a numeric data domain into a visual range and enables clamping. Browser/editor content: import D3 in the target page or bundle; Hypershell's Web APIs surface is intentionally editor-only.

examples.title: Map scores to pixels
examples.explanation: The domain describes data values and the range describes output values; clamping keeps outliers within the visual extent.

guides.definition: Creates rectangular SVG bars from data using D3 scales. Browser/editor content: import D3 in the target page or bundle; Hypershell's Web APIs surface is intentionally editor-only.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: CSS selector for the SVG element.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Array containing label and numeric value properties.

examples.title: Render category values
examples.explanation: Band scales allocate categorical positions while the inverted linear range maps larger values higher in SVG coordinates.
